label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 71A

obligations.text:
Codes of conduct
(1)
The Commission must encourage expert public bodies to produce codes of conduct intended to contribute to compliance with this Part.

(2)
Under subsection (1), the Commission must, among other things, encourage the production of codes which take account of the specific features of the various processing sectors.

(5)
The Commission must encourage expert public bodies to submit codes of conduct described in subsection (1) to the Commission in draft.

(6)
Where an expert public body does so, the Commission must—
(a)
provide the body with an opinion on whether the code correctly reflects the requirements of this Part,
(b)
decide whether to approve the code, and
(c)
if the code is approved, register and publish the code.
